children.value: > Fact From Story: The deal between Google and Apple makes Google the default search engine on all Apple devices and pays Apple billions of dollars a year.
> > Fact From Story: Cue is one of the highest-profile witnesses in the case so far because the deal between Google and Apple is central to the US Department of Justice’s case against Google.
> > > Fact From Story: The ISA has been in place since 2002.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Deals are renegotiated to make sure they are still mutually beneficial.
> > Fact From Story: Cue is on the stand as a witness in US v. Google, the landmark antitrust trial over Google’s search business.
> > > > > > Fact From Story: Apple is in court because of something called the Information Services Agreement, or ISA: a deal that makes Google’s search engine the default on Apple’s products.
> > > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Apple being in court over the ISA indicates the deal is in question.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: High profile witnesses are called for important cases.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A deal that brings in billions of dollars a year is of central importance.
